arm: VUPN2355 6-DOF 25kg digital servo educational desktop robotic arm V2
_status_note: Every value whose `sources` entry is "assumed" is a datasheet or product-page figure, or an inference from one -- NOT a measurement. The arm is in hand, so run m1_checklist and rewrite those values with `sources` set to "measured". bench/analyze_arm_envelope.py and the ablation runs stamp this file's status and hash into their output, so a number produced from assumed geometry is never mistaken for a measured one.

control._command_rate_note: Set by bench/libero-action-units.json: one env.step per predicted action, and the recorded episode is 10 Hz. 20 Hz playback degrades tracking from 9 mm to 207 mm, so this is not a free parameter.

controller_scaling._source: robosuite OSC_POSE default (venv/.../robosuite/controllers/config/osc_pose.json), control_delta=true. Read back from the live env at runtime by the ablation harness and recorded in provenance -- these copies are for the offline envelope analysis only.

libero_reference._robot_base_note: THE BASE POSITION IS SCENE-DEPENDENT, so no single value is recorded here to be misused. Across libero_10, sim.data.get_body_xpos(robots[0].robot_model.root_body) returns three distinct values: [-0.51, 0, 0.42] (tasks 0,1,4,6,7), [-0.66, 0, 0.912] (tasks 2,3,8,9) and [-0.75, 0, 0.912] (task 5). Reach must be measured per task from the live sim, which bench/verify_arm_workspace.py does and bench/analyze_arm_envelope.py deliberately does not attempt.
libero_reference._reach_source: Franka datasheet, for context on why LIBERO scenes span what they do. Not a measurement of ours.

m1_checklist: COUNT THE SERVOS and identify each axis. Confirm 5 positioning joints + 1 gripper, not 6 positioning joints. Everything in project_5dof() rests on this; if it is really 6 positioning joints, that whole ablation is unnecessary.
reach_max_mm: base pivot axis to the closed gripper tip, arm fully extended horizontally. NOT the 370 mm product-page bounding box, which includes the base plate.
reach_min_mm: smallest radius the tip can reach while still pointing usefully downward -- the dead zone directly over the base.
base_travel_deg / joint_travel_deg: drive each joint gently to each mechanical limit BY HAND (no power) and record the swept angle. Do not power into an endstop.
backlash_deg: hold the link above a joint, wiggle the link below it, measure the free play at the tip in mm and convert using that joint's radius.

DEFERRED until the wiring brief's questions are settled -- these need the PCA9685 powered: pulse-width-to-angle calibration per servo, slew under load, gravity sag at full extension, per-servo current draw.
